thread:
mia.cs: FYI — ran the playbook gated rollout dry-run for the onboarding healthscore updates and noticed ~1.2k accounts where the playbook did not fire.
ashwin.sre: ugh, that explains the missing recalcs in metrics. any quick repro?
lena.cse: seeing it too. looks like the gating lambda returned `SKIP` for accounts with `pre_onboard_v2` tag even though the rule should have matched.
mia.cs: repro steps I used: run `runbook:dryrun --batch=5000 --ruleset=healthscore_v3` against staging snapshot `2026-03-18`. 1200 accounts flagged SKIP.
ashwin.sre: can you paste the rule id?
mia.cs: rule id `hs_rule_2026_v3` and gating policy `gate_playbook_if_verified=true, allow_manual_override=false`.
ashwin.sre: checking logs... cs-bot: PlaybookDryRun started (id: dryrun-4851236789)
cs-bot: GateEval: rule=hs_rule_2026_v3, account=acct_0x9f, result=SKIP, reason=tag_mismatch
lena.cse: that log reason is misleading — the account has `pre_onboard_v2` tag, the rule should include that tag. suspect the tag canonicalizer service returned old key `pre-onboard` after the last deploy.
rafael.prod: timeline: last night we rolled canonicalizer v2.1 which normalized tag names; we merged `pre-onboard` -> `pre_onboard_v2`. might have a race.
mia.cs: mitigation proposal: 1) pause gated rollout (stop canary) 2) run backfill to recalc healthscore for accounts where playbook didn't fire 3) patch canonicalizer to be idempotent for tag reads
lena.cse: agree. quick SQL to find affected accounts: ```sql
SELECT account_id FROM account_tags
WHERE tag_key IN ('pre-onboard','pre_onboard_v2')
GROUP BY account_id
HAVING SUM(tag_key='pre_onboard_v2')=0 AND SUM(tag_key='pre-onboard')>0;
```
ashwin.sre: for immediate stop I can flip the rollout flag to `paused`. who owns backfill?
mia.cs: i'll take ownership of backfill (run as dry-run first). ETA: 3 hours for a test pass, full run tomorrow morning.
rafael.prod: i'll open a quick rollback PR for canonicalizer fallback so reads fallback to old key if new key missing. label `urgent/cs`
lena.cse: assigning tasks: @mia.cs backfill dry-run; @ashwin.sre pause rollout and monitor; @rafael.prod PR + deploy patch; I'll coordinate validation with a 11:30 AM sync.
ashwin.sre: paused the canary rollout (flag: playbook.healthscore.v3.canary=false) :white_check_mark:
cs-bot: PlaybookDryRun finished (id: dryrun-4851236789, matches: 0 active canary rules)
mia.cs: test dry-run queued: I'll post results here when finished. thanks all. :pray:
rafael.prod: opened PR https://git.internal/redwood/canonicalizer/pull/341 — fallback + unit test added
lena.cse: once backfill dry-run shows expected matches, we should run a targeted re-run for the rolling 1.2k accounts rather than full sweep to avoid double-charges.
mia.cs: agreed. dry-run complete: 1.2k accounts moved from SKIP -> MATCH in staging after canonicalizer hotfix. posting sample payloads in gist.
cs-bot: BackfillJob queued (id: backfill-4851236796)
mia.cs: starting targeted backfill now, will monitor token usage and healthscore deltas. leaving a postmortem stub in internal docs repo.
lena.cse: add note for next release: add integration test for tag canonicalization in playbook gating flow. small follow-up task.
ashwin.sre: monitoring dashboard green so far. revert plan in place if errors spike.
rafael.prod: thanks team — good catch before wide rollout. :tada:
